markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If legislation that grants legal status to a class of undocumented immigrants has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying law grants legal status to a class of people who are in the U.S. without lawful status, such as Dreamers, long-term workers or farmworkers, whether named the Dignity Act, the Dream Act, the Farm Workforce Modernization Act or anything else. Legal status means protection from removal together with work authorization, or conditional or lawful permanent resident status.

Legislation that only grants status to named individuals, only designates or extends Temporary Protected Status or Deferred Enforced Departure, only provides parole or release from custody, only changes visa or green-card numbers or caps for people abroad, or only adjusts the status of people who already hold Temporary Protected Status, parole or another lawful status does NOT qualify.

It may be any vehicle, including a larger package whose text as enacted contains a qualifying provision. Committee approval or passage by only one chamber does NOT count.
markets.title: Will undocumented immigrants be granted legal status?

markets.rules_primary: If the full nationwide taking effect of Trump's Executive Order 14418 for all people it covers before January 1, 2027 is confirmed by any of the Source Agencies after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency, that A) explicitly states the full nationwide taking effect of Trump's Executive Order 14418 for all people it covers before January 1, 2027 occurred, is true, or has been verified, B) based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

Full nationwide effect means federal agencies may legally implement EO 14418 throughout the United States for every covered category. Signing, publication, guidance, or partial applicability does not qualify. Any continuing federal block for a covered person, category, territory, or jurisdiction prevents Yes. A later block does not undo an earlier qualifying period.
markets.title: Will Trump's Executive Order 14418 take full effect before 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If People's Republic of China agrees to or announces the formal abolition of all nationwide numerical limits on the number of children an individual or couple may have before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments
